HTCU.craft_notes: Clean outlined vectors, bold waves and scalable flame; sheet has excessive empty middle space but lockups remain legible.

VTCH.craft_notes: Warm expressive serif and simple high-contrast badge form a cohesive identity. Real vector outlines, all ICO sizes and opaque square app icon verified.
VTCH.revision_notes: Business name correctly changed in lockups and sheet. New tagline incorrectly capitalized. Stacked sheet lockups shrink substantially to accommodate longer name; standalone mark, favicon and app icon are byte-identical, appropriately carrying no text.

pairwise_round1.why: VTCH's warmer wordmark and stronger amber-on-navy badge produce a more coherent café identity and better small-size contrast.
